create_RPG_model: create an RPG model instance with config, dataset, and tokenizer for recommendation tasks
run_RPG_forward: run the RPG model forward pass on a batch to compute final states and loss
build_item_similarity_matrix: build an item-item similarity matrix using token embeddings and cosine similarity
generate_recommendations: generate top-k item recommendations from a batch using the RPG model
init_graph_decoding: initialize the decoding graph by building adjacency list from item similarity matrix
